power.id: Ular raksasa yang menelan gajah dan memuntahkan tulangnya setelah tiga tahun, hingga panjang 100 xun menurut Guo Pu.
power.en: A giant serpent that swallows elephants and disgorges the bones after three years, up to 100 xun long according to Guo Pu.

threat.id: Riset hanya mencatat mangsa gajah; kaitan dengan korban Houyi adalah tafsir sarjana; ancaman belum dinilai.
threat.en: The research records only elephant prey; the link to Houyi’s victims is a scholar’s reading; threat is not assessed.

fear.id: Ular yang menelan mangsa sebesar gajah menimbulkan rasa takut ditelan hidup-hidup.
fear.en: A serpent that gulps prey as large as an elephant evokes the fear of being swallowed whole.

power.id: Dalam arti chimei, siluman gunung dan hutan yang lahir dari qi ganjil, menyerupai harimau bersisik; dasar Superhuman.
power.en: In the chimei sense, a mountain and forest demon born of strange qi, resembling a scaled tiger, supports Superhuman.

threat.id: Komentar Du Yu menyebut chimei membahayakan manusia, tanpa catatan skala; dinilai individu.
threat.en: Du Yu’s commentary calls the chimei harmful to humans, with no recorded scale; assessed as individual.

fear.id: Siluman yang lahir dari qi ganjil pegunungan berada di luar hukum alam; dalam arti lain, chi hanyalah naga tanpa tanduk dalam seni.
fear.en: A demon born of the strange qi of mountains lies beyond natural law; in its other sense chi is simply a hornless dragon in art.

power.id: Menurut desas-desus, hantu telur dapat menjadi telur, bersembunyi, dan muncul sesuka hati.
power.en: Rumour holds that egg ghosts can turn into an egg, hide and come out when they wish.

threat.id: Legenda menyebut orang yang melihatnya akan mati; skala individu.
threat.en: Legend says a person who sees it will die; individual scale.

fear.id: Hantu tanpa wajah yang cukup dilihat untuk membawa kematian menegaskan betapa sedikit kendali manusia.
fear.en: A faceless ghost that brings death merely by being seen stresses how little control humans have.

power.id: Burung roh yang menurut Sancai Tuhui adalah penjelmaan roh ilahi, dan kemunculannya menandakan dunia damai.
power.en: A spirit bird that the Sancai Tuhui calls a transformation of a divine spirit, whose appearance signals a world at peace.

threat.id: Riset tidak memuat perbuatan merusak; ancaman belum dinilai.
threat.en: The research holds no destructive deeds; threat is not assessed.

fear.id: Riset menggambarkan burung pertanda damai, bukan sumber rasa takut; Fear belum dinilai.
fear.en: The research describes a bird that omens peace, not a source of fear; Fear is not assessed.

power.id: Sisik kerasnya disebut tahan panah, melampaui hewan sungai biasa.
power.en: Its hard scales are said to resist arrows, beyond ordinary river animals.

threat.id: Riset tidak memuat korban atau serangan; ancaman belum dinilai.
threat.en: The research holds no victims or attacks; threat is not assessed.

fear.id: Makhluk sungai seukuran anak kecil yang berjemur di gosong pasir dengan cakar tersembunyi di air terasa ganjil.
fear.en: A child-sized river creature basking on sandbars with its claws hidden in the water feels uncanny.

power.id: Binatang langka sebesar harimau yang, bila ditunggangi, menempuh seribu li dalam sehari.
power.en: A rare beast as large as a tiger that, when ridden, covers a thousand li in a day.

threat.id: Ia digambarkan lembut dan sepenuhnya vegetarian; ancaman belum dinilai.
threat.en: It is described as gentle and strictly vegetarian; threat is not assessed.

fear.id: Riset menggambarkan hewan pertanda baik yang lembut, bukan sumber rasa takut; Fear belum dinilai.
fear.en: The research describes a gentle animal of good omen, not a source of fear; Fear is not assessed.
